text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp begins. I intended to 
keep a low profile so as not to get in the 
way of the top two, T.M. Opera O and 
Admire Vega, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Recognized far more than she expected and 
welcomed into their circle, Meisho Doto is 
overjoyed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, for some reason, a local 
tanuki took a liking to them, kicking off 
a summer for three people + one critter.
